evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: Contrasts owned vs. rented as a proportionality distinction — value retained vs. value paid for — enacting market-pricing without naming a price.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep

observations.why: Framing perspective as an asset to keep restates the owned-vs-rented proportionality: what you retain versus what is commodity.
